verses.1: Oh, city of bloodshed! It’s like a net filled with blood; no one can escape its grasp.
verses.2: The sound of hooves, the noise of horses galloping, and the music of dancing horses.
verses.3: He ascends above the stars; he is the light that shines brightly. He rules over the vast universe. But there’s no end to his power. His reign lasts forever.
verses.4: Many women are good in bed; they are very attractive. They can seduce men and families with their beauty.
verses.5: I am here before you, O LORD, with Your armies. I have seen nations being destroyed by your power, and kings being overthrown by your might.
verses.6: And I will throw dirt upon you, and you will be covered with filth. You will be treated as an object of contempt.
verses.7: And every one who sees you will be filled with sorrow. They will say, “Who can comfort her from the ends of the earth?” I seek comfort for you.
verses.8: She was surrounded by waters that flowed around her. The sea rushed upon her from all directions.
verses.9: May they be saved from Egypt, and may there be no more suffering. May their hearts be in your care.
verses.10: She also went down into the valley. All her limbs were broken, and her head was crushed. Her hands were tied up, and all her organs were damaged.
verses.11: And even you will be deceived; you will be deceived as well. And even you will ask for payment from your enemies.
verses.12: All your enemies will be destroyed by blows from weapons; they will fall down due to the weight of their own bodies.
verses.13: Look! Your women are open in your midst to your enemies. The doors of your land have been opened; fire has been kindled in your land.
verses.14: From the prison of Sh’abi-lak, I will free myself from your captivity. Come, let us go into the pit and be free from your control. Hold me tightly in your arms.
verses.15: There, you will eat fire; you will be destroyed. You will eat ashes. You will be like the ashes that are scattered everywhere.
verses.16: Your desires increase with the stars in the sky; they become more and more numerous.
verses.17: Your trees are like flowers, and your branches are like branches of trees in the garden. On a cold day, when the sun shines brightly, it’s hard to know where it is.
verses.18: Your kings have been defeated by the king of Assyria. Your people have been exiled to the mountains, and there is no place for them to go.
verses.19: There is no one who will not be affected by your suffering. All those who hear your words will place their hands on you, because who else but them will suffer from your troubles?
